sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Visa reported a revenue base of [[V.fact.revenue]] with year‑over‑year growth of [[V.ratio.revenue_growth]]. The operating margin of [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] reflects strong profitability, while the return on average equity of [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] shows efficient capital use. Debt‑to‑equity of [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]] points to a balanced financing structure, and free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] demonstrates robust cash generation after capital expenditures of [[V.fact.capex]]. GAAP diluted EPS of [[V.fact.diluted_eps]] pertains to the Class A common share class, and the price‑earnings multiple of [[V.ratio.price_earnings]] is based on the close price of [[V.price]].
